purpose: Logo and name concepts for selection; not applied to the website yet.

concepts.name: Perch
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a finished landscape brand identity concept board for a personal YouTube companion website.
Create one sophisticated original logo identity for the exact brand name "Perch". Positioning: a comfortable personal home for hundreds of followed channels, easy to browse, thoughtfully organized. Distinctive icon: an abstract compact perched bird built from confident asymmetric rounded geometry, an elegant wing cutout subtly suggesting watching / a forward motion, a small grounded perch. Not a cartoon mascot. Make it immediately recognizable and attractive at 24 pixels, with carefully balanced negative space and simple flat silhouettes.
Pair with an expertly kerned custom humanist geometric wordmark "Perch" in cream, medium-bold, warm but precise, subtly customized terminal or letter detail. This should feel like a premium independent product brand, crafted by a talented identity studio.
Palette: warm amber #FFB020, cream #F6F1E8, midnight #0D1117. Flat vector-like edges, no gradients or effects.
Composition: landscape 1536x1024 concept board with generous editorial whitespace and restrained grid. Upper 70 percent is midnight, containing a dominant centered horizontal icon + wordmark. Beneath the lockup, very small tasteful tagline exactly "Your channels. Your pace.". Lower 30 percent is cream and contains three small clearly separated usage proofs: amber icon alone, a monochrome black lockup, a 32-pixel favicon in a dark rounded square. All are consistent reproductions of the same identity, not alternate logos. No decorative diagrams, no extra branding, no stock mockups, no unrelated graphics. Board should be beautifully composed, polished, restrained, and readable, the logo is the hero. No YouTube or Google logo imitation. Text only "Perch" and "Your channels. Your pace.".

concepts.name: Rill
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a finished landscape brand identity concept board for a personal video discovery website.
Create one exceptional original logo identity for the exact brand name "Rill". A rill is a small flowing stream; this product makes a busy video feed feel smooth, personal and uncluttered. Distinctive icon: two or three very simple continuous ribbon-like flat paths, flowing forward and weaving into a subtle lowercase r / stream motif, with one precise negative-space notch. The mark must feel ownable, calm, fluid, brilliantly simple and recognizable at 24 pixels. Avoid a generic radio-wave icon, a standard play triangle, or the Slack logo.
Wordmark "Rill": beautiful bespoke lowercase-friendly typography but the exact spelling has capital R, a soft geometric sans, carefully crafted R and paired ll stems, precise kerning. A premium digital identity studio's refined work.
Palette: luminous soft mint #7CE4C4, pale ice #F2F8F5, deep pine-black #0C1717. Use flat color, extremely crisp vector-like edges, no gradients, no bevels.
Composition: landscape 1536x1024 concept board, generous editorial whitespace, restrained grid. Upper 70 percent is deep pine-black with one dominant centered horizontal icon + wordmark in mint and pale ice. Beneath it a very small tasteful tagline exactly "A better flow of video.". Lower 30 percent is pale ice and contains three small clearly separated usage proofs: mint icon alone, monochrome black lockup, a 32-pixel favicon in a dark rounded square. These repeat exactly the main identity, not different designs. Beautifully balanced scale and alignment. No extra text, no slogans except the specified line, no background decoration, no stock objects or mockups. Design should be genuinely polished and distinctive, not generic SaaS clipart. Text only "Rill" and "A better flow of video.".

concepts.name: Orbit
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a finished landscape brand identity concept board for a personal video platform.
Create one original, high-end logo identity for the exact name "Orbit". Product idea: all the channels you love in your own orbit, with effortless discovery and control. Distinctive geometric icon: an open circular orbit with a single small satellite node and an elegant offset inner arc. Explore a subtle O plus the feeling of a video queue through the negative space. Must be a confident, timeless, simple silhouette that works at 24 pixels. Avoid a literal planet illustration, a browser logo, the generic atom symbol, the YouTube play button, or elaborate swirls.
Wordmark "Orbit": impeccably kerned custom geometric sans with confident rounded O and distinctive angled or cut t terminal, slightly futuristic but friendly and readable. Designed like an independent professional identity studio's flagship digital brand.
Palette: vivid periwinkle #A99BFF, cool white #F6F5FF, ink-black #11101A. Flat vector-like precision. No glows, no gradients, no metallic material.
Composition: landscape 1536x1024 polished concept board with generous negative space and restrained editorial grid. Upper 70 percent ink-black with one dominant centered horizontal symbol + wordmark in periwinkle and white, and a very small elegant tagline exactly "Keep your favourites close.". Lower 30 percent cool white, containing three small clearly separated usage proofs: periwinkle icon alone, monochrome black horizontal lockup, a 32-pixel favicon inside a dark rounded square. Every usage must use the identical symbol as the main identity. No extra text, no UI clutter, no background patterns, no stock scenes, no alternate competing marks. High-end restrained branding. Text only "Orbit" and "Keep your favourites close.".
